manifest.name: Accessibility Captions
installationSteps: Choose public event types and visual settings.
Add /overlay/addons/thsv.accessibility-captions as a browser source, preview, then enable.
uninstallationSteps: No caption text history is retained.

healthChecks.description: Confirms ephemeral accessible captions are available.
